note: A tier-above directory, read by INVERSION: each page tested against every candidate on the ballot, rather than each candidate searched for separately. A page naming exactly ONE candidate on an official host is that candidate's verified page; a page naming several is the roster they are listed on, and a roster is nobody's own page. The technique travels; the seeds are per-state, because New England's shape is not New Jersey's (RULING 60). Written by scripts/directory-inversion-0825.mts.
